title: Arcsine odd power coefficient
statement: For a natural number $k$, the arcsine odd power coefficient is zero when $k$ is even; when $k$ is odd, it is $\displaystyle \frac{2\binom{k-1}{(k-1)/2}}{k2^k}$.
hypotheses_covered: the coefficient is defined by separate cases according to whether $k$ is odd
